evidence.clarity: 1440 and 390: H1 'The 2:30 that just cancelled gets filled from your waitlist.' plus sub 'Chairtime is a cancellation-filling service for small physical therapy clinics... texts your waitlist one person at a time... then tells the front desk who is coming' states what, for whom and how; CTA 'Book a 15-minute setup call' sits beside it with 'A working session, not a pitch' line. Nothing later contradicts it.
evidence.fit: Patient path is in the hero ('Got a text from Chairtime? What it is and how to reply.') and gets a full section with YES/NO/CANCEL/STOP and a three-point legitimacy check. HIPAA handled in plain words in the rules section and on the call agenda. Example uses sample clinic and made-up patients as briefed. The missing scheduling link is handled only weakly: the hero CTA scrolls to #setup-call and the card's own 'Book a 15-minute setup call' button links to itself.
evidence.distinctiveness: Editorial serif (Charter/Schola) on warm paper with mono timestamps reads like an appointment book rather than SaaS; the day-strip of 1:30-3:30 slots and the annotated text cards (01-06 callouts on what each SMS contains) are product-born. The section rhythm (left heading/right content, numbered three steps, setup CTA) is still a familiar template.
evidence.proof: 1440: stage starts at y=557, so the schedule strip with '2:30 Marcus O. evidence.craft: Strong type scale (clamp H1 to 76px, 1.04 leading) and consistent rules/borders. Defects: 1440 hero right column is bottom-aligned, leaving ~250px of empty space above the CTA beside the headline; 390 step 3 badge 'Offering, 2nd person' wraps to three lines and pushes the step grid down; the front-desk boxes in the thread at 1440 cap at ~510px leaving a wide empty right half of the thread pane.
evidence.mobile: 390: nav becomes a wrapped row of 44px links (no menu needed), step buttons recompose into a 2x2 grid at 157x80-99px, Replay 44px, no overflow (probe 0px at 390/320). But the artifact starts at y=704, and tapping a step updates the strip and note while the new texts appear below the fold (step 2: thread bottom at 1151 on an 844 viewport after tapping at ~1026).
evidence.honesty: Every example labelled where it appears ('(sample)' in strip, 'sample' on the waitlist row, footer note); HIPAA stated as in progress; pricing honestly 'quoted on the call'. Booking disclosure ('Our calendar link is being connected. Until it is live, this page cannot take a booking') only appears in the setup-call card, after the hero CTA has been clicked; the hero copy 'we load your waitlist with you and send a test text to your phone' reads as bookable.
evidence.interaction: All four step buttons work by click with aria-pressed state and role=status note; Replay plays 1->4 at 900ms and toggles to 'Stop the replay', then back. No console errors at any width. Dead control: 1440/768/390, the 'Book a 15-minute setup call' button inside the .book card (href=#setup-call) does nothing when clicked (scrollY unchanged at 4136 at 1440). At 390 feedback for new texts lands off-screen.
evidence.copy: Specific, customer-world words throughout: 'Your front desk marks the cancellation. That is the whole job.', 'NO, or no reply inside the window, passes it on', 'The address is repeated so the patient has no reason to call the desk', 'If it is not, you keep the loaded list.' Button labels say what happens; the agenda by minute is concrete. Terms consistent (waitlist, reply window, front desk).
evidence.first_screen: 1440: specific promise, audience in sub, CTA, and the strip showing 'Filled 1:31' plus 'Cancelled at 1:12, filled by 1:31.' all in view, but the step controls are below the fold. 390: headline, sub and CTA in view; only the strip header and top of slots peek at the bottom, so nothing that makes the promise believable is readable without scrolling.

problems: No honest booking path: hero CTA jumps to a section where the repeated 'Book a 15-minute setup call' button links to itself and does nothing; the 'cannot take a booking' disclosure sits only in small muted text there.
390: the SMS thread is stacked below the step grid, so tapping a step shows its texts off-screen; the artifact itself starts at y=704.
1440 hero composition leaves a large empty block above the right-hand CTA cluster, so the first screen feels unbalanced and pushes the demo controls below the fold.

evidence.clarity: H1 'A cancelled 2:30 doesn't have to stay empty.' is half slogan; the lede 'Chairtime texts the patients on your waitlist, one at a time, until somebody takes the slot' carries the meaning, and the audience ('For small physical therapy clinics') only appears in grey fine print below the CTA at 1440/768/390.
evidence.fit: Patient path in hero ('Got a text from us? Start here') and a full section with YES/NO/STOP, 'How to know it's us' and a sample phone; dedicated 'Where we stand on HIPAA' band with no compliance claim; no-link constraint handled by a modal on every booking button. Rules section (order, reply window, minimum notice, quiet hours, per-patient limit) answers owner questions well.
evidence.distinctiveness: Clock-hands-at-2:30 logo and the dark-header clinic board are product-specific. Everything else is the category kit: teal SaaS palette, geometric sans, two-column hero with product panel, numbered 4-step how-it-works, dark trust band, FAQ, tinted CTA band.
evidence.proof: 1440: the whole board (Today slots, Waitlist with status pills, Texts pane, caption, controls, 'An example, not a live clinic' note) is in the first screen and autoplays when in view: Cancelled 11:04 -> Reply by 11:14 -> Passed -> Reply by 11:19 -> Said yes -> Filled 11:12, waitlist pills Texted/Passed/Took it/Not texted. Weakness: it opens on an empty state ('No texts yet', all Booked) and takes ~14s at 2.4s/step to reach the payoff, so a scanning visitor sees nothing happen first.
evidence.craft: Clean, consistent tokens and spacing; board is tidy at all widths. Defects: 320 header button wraps to two lines and the hero CTA wraps with line-height 1 ('Book a 15-minute setup / call'); step dots are 9px marks in 22px hit areas; 1440 hero has an empty band of ~170px under the board; HIPAA dark band body text #DCE6E3 at 17px is fine but the section break feels template-dropped.
evidence.mobile: 390: stacks without overflow (probe 0px), board recomposes to one column with a 250px internally scrolling thread that auto-scrolls to the newest text and caption directly below, so feedback is near the controls. But nav links are display:none with no menu (only 'Book a setup call' remains), play button is 34px and step dots 22x22px, and the board starts at y=630 so the demo is a scroll away.
evidence.honesty: Board labelled 'An example, not a live clinic. The clinic and patients are made up.' at its foot; HIPAA candid. But booking disclosure arrives only after the click (modal 'Booking opens shortly... this button isn't connected yet'), while the pre-click copy at the setup section says 'Pick a time that suits your front desk. We'll call you.'; 'shortly' implies a timeline; 'Most clinics pick something between five and fifteen minutes' asserts customer behaviour the brief does not supply.
evidence.interaction: Operated at 1440/768/390: autoplay starts on intersection, Pause/Play toggles aria-label, all seven step dots jump to full board states, Replay appears at the end and restarts; reduced-motion shows final state. Booking buttons in nav, hero and setup section all open the dialog; Escape and 'Okay' close it; in-dialog links close it and scroll to #call. No console errors. Minus: tiny dot targets, and the modal is a dead end with no way to leave contact.
evidence.copy: Good specific lines: 'Confirmed. The 2:30 is filled, and Hannah was never bothered.', 'Don't offer a slot that starts in less than, say, 45 minutes. Nobody can get there in time, and the text just annoys them.', 'Nothing to integrate, nothing to migrate.' Headline is generic-leaning, and 'Booking opens shortly' is vague microcopy.
evidence.first_screen: 1440: promise, CTA, patient link and the full operating demo board with its example label all in one viewport (board 121-682px). 390: headline, lede, CTA and patient link visible; only the board's dark header and first two slots peek at the bottom, the playing state is not visible without scrolling, and audience is in small grey text.

problems: Booking honesty: every 'Book a 15-minute setup call' opens a 'Booking opens shortly' modal only after the click, and the setup section says 'Pick a time... We'll call you' beforehand; no way to leave details.

Template structure and SaaS teal look (two-column hero, 4-step list, dark trust band, FAQ, CTA band) make it hard to recognise without the logo; the headline is closer to a slogan than a specific promise for a named audience.
Mobile controls under size (22px step dots, 34px play) and nav links simply hidden at 390; demo opens on an empty 'No texts yet' state and takes ~14s to reach the filled result.

reason: A has the stronger point of view: the editorial appointment-book type, the slot strip with its result-first default state and the annotated text cards come from this product, and its copy is sharper for both owners and patients. B wins the 1440 first screen and has the better-built interactive board, and if B's demo started on the filled state and A's dead in-card booking button were fixed I would see them as nearly level; a reviewer weighting the 1440 first screen and demo mechanics most could reasonably prefer B.
